items.title: Russell Brand tells court allegations had devastating impact on him
items.summary: The entertainer begins giving evidence at his trial on charges including rape at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Knife attacker shot dead by police outside Israeli embassy
items.summary: A man carrying knives has been killed by police after attacking an officer outside the Israeli embassy in Belgrade.

items.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey will reveal the new pay rates in the Budget, and has also announced measures to help households with the cost of living.

items.title: Zookeeper dies after leopard attack
items.summary: A woman has died after being attacked by a leopard at the safari park where she spent almost her entire 40-year career.

items.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
items.summary: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.

items.title: US embassy worker flown out of UK before police questioning
items.summary: A senior US Air Force officer was flown out of the UK before he could be questioned over allegations that he possessed child sexual abuse images, it has emerged.
